Interior Design, the design authority, shapes design opinions, while providing boundless inspiration and vital information through compelling coverage of the most groundbreaking projects, products, and people in the industry.

This app includes downloadable versions of the most recent issues of Interior Design Magazine, available via in-app purchase, or via a Digital Subscription.

SkyNews is a hands-on magazine for amateur astronomers in Canada. It’s written for active stargazers including beginners and intermediates. Each issue contains a current Star Chart for Canada and the northern U.S., seasonal observing tips, expert equipment reviews, space news, a Photo Gallery of reader’s best astrophotos and much more. Edited by popular astronomy author Terrence Dickinson, SkyNews features some of the world’s best science writers including Alen Dyer, Ken Hewitt-White, Gary Seronik, David Levy, Ray Villard and others.

Woodworking Crafts brings you a breadth of knowledge and information which cannot be found in any other woodworking publication on the market. Whether you are a first time woodworker or experienced, there will always be something for you. It has lots of technique articles, features and projects across a wide range of woodworking interests from green woodworking to woodturning, craft projects, upcycling, learnt hand skills, powertool use, the green environment and much more. It is approachable and easy to understand, educational and fun. If you have a thirst for knowledge this is a magazine you will want to keep picking up and reading, a magazine you’ll want to keep. Formerly known as Woodworking Plans & Projects.

Outdoor Photography is for the serious amateur and semi-professional photographer who is passionate about the British countryside and its wildlife. It is the UK’s only photography magazine dedicated exclusively to the coverage of landscape, wildlife and the environment. Each issue features an inspiring array of landscape and wildlife photographs with regular contributions by Britain’s leading photographers. The magazine is also renowned for its field tests of cameras and other relevant equipment plus informed techniques and instruction by leading photographers.
